description: This Java source file defines the SecurityUtil class which provides utility methods related to user permission checks, JWT token generation and validation, specifically within the OFBiz framework's security module.

classes.name: SecurityUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for permission checking, JWT token management, and permission hierarchy validation within the OFBiz security framework.

methods.name: hasUserLoginAdminPermission
methods.description: Checks if a user with a given userLoginId has at least one of the predefined admin permissions.

methods.name: hasUserLoginMorePermissionThan
methods.description: Compares permissions between two user logins and returns permissions that the second user login has more of than the first.

methods.name: checkMultiLevelAdminPermissionValidity
methods.description: Determines if an admin permission is valid through multi-level permission suffix checks.

methods.name: generateJwtToAuthenticateUserLogin
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for a userLogin, salted with userLoginId and currentPassword.

methods.name: authenticateUserLoginByJWT
methods.description: Verifies a JWT token for a userLoginId, ensuring token validity and coherence.
